author: Ifmyante
text:
DKD

In some cases PA is made to fill orders, sure. There are many savvy
lesser banks looking to make a profit, and many terrorist organisations
to be funded.

But in many other instances, PA is made simply to take the stops of everybody in the market.

CPLQ can form when there are many stops spread over a wide area. The ITs
 will keep taking them until they're all gone, or price has hit their
barrier

author: Enkim

Hi Hugo, i must say it is difficult to me to understand your question
as well, but from your last post i will try to add something too :) I
think IF pointed out these zones like you said to watch the price doing
PA after it goes there. So If it would be up to me to trade there, i
would set an alarm there, and after price reaches it, i would look for
PA in LTF as confirmation that these zones are really their target. My
first target would be as usuall in LFT and final target would be in HTF.
 I know that you already know this very well, thats why i have struggle
to understand your question. May be you are overthinking it too much?
 About scale : when price reaches these zones i would watch m1 PA, if no
 valid eng is present i would wait for higher TF engulfs as well. It is
possible and very often seen, that price reacts to for example H4 zone
(kink from h4 LS for example) and then it makes engulf in H4, return to
QM and continues. So i think there is no rule about PA in certain TF.
Just watch PA in general around these zones (like IF said in video 2)
Hope it somehow helps you..

edit : now that i read your posts again, i have a feeling i can finally see what you are asking
 . And yes it is not easy to answer :) If i am right you want to connect
 those two videos together. I would suggest to draw whole FLs and treat
them the way IF treated them in video 1. When price does PA after it
reaches the edge of whole FL (black or brown one) you can trade QM there
 or wait for DM in mpl (IFs zones).

author: Enkim
text:
Hi, i will try to answer in AUDUSD charts (attachments). In general
your pink zone is not FL, its just QM zone. Let say that it was reaction
 to some kind of FL in the past and it is valid. Than you can search for
 engulf in highs around 0,8115 in your picture. If there would be ENG
then you can safely trade your pink zone with SL under the FL it is
reacting to. Or you can wait for price to touch kink of some LS there
(on real chart there wasnt any kink). Let say your third picture is
showing red kink. Then you can treat it as small FL, and after price
touche it you will watch for engulf north in M1, then M5 and so on.
